info.title: AgentGuard Core Engine
info.description: Framework-Agnostic Runtime Governance Layer for Autonomous AI Agents

post.description:
Register a new user.

Organization creation logic (ambiguity noted in Phase 3 report):
- If `organization_slug` is provided and the org exists → join that org.
- If `organization_slug` is provided and the org does NOT exist → create org + make this user ADMIN.
- If no `organization_slug` is provided → generate slug from email domain + uuid4 suffix,
  create a new org, and make this user ADMIN.
Authenticate and return a JWT access token.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile.
List all active API keys for the current organization.

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Api V1 Auth Api Keys Get

post.description: Create a new API key. The raw key is shown ONCE — store it securely.

delete.description: Revoke an API key. Revoked keys are rejected immediately on next use.

get.description: List all non-deleted agents for the current organization.

schema.title: Response List Agents Api V1 Agents Get

post.description:
Register a new agent and provision its API key.

The plaintext API key is returned ONCE in this response and is never
stored or logged in plaintext. Subsequent GETs return only the prefix.

get.description: Get a single agent by ID. Returns 404 if not in current org or deleted.

patch.description: Update agent metadata. ADMIN and SECURITY only.

delete.description:
Soft-delete an agent (status → DELETED).

Choice: soft delete, not hard delete. Audit logs and tool_requests that
reference this agent's ID must still resolve for forensic/regulatory use.
Hard delete would break the audit hash chain. Flagged as a design choice.

get.description: List all tools (active and inactive) for the current organization.

schema.title: Response List Tools Api V1 Tools Get

post.description: Register a new tool in the organization's registry.

get.description: Get a single tool by ID.

patch.description:
Update tool metadata including risk level and enabled status.

Set is_active=false to retire a tool without deleting it.
ADMIN and SECURITY only.

get.description: List all agent-tool permissions for the current organization.

schema.title: Response List Permissions Api V1 Permissions Get

post.description:
Grant (or update) an agent's permission to use a tool.

Idempotent: assigning the same (agent_id, tool_id) twice does not
duplicate the row — it updates is_allowed and returns 200.
ADMIN and SECURITY only.

delete.description:
Revoke a permission — hard-deletes the permission row.

Returns 404 if the permission does not exist.
ADMIN and SECURITY only.

get.description: List all agent permissions for a specific tool.

schema.title: Response List Tool Permissions Api V1 Permissions Tools  Tool Id  Get

get.description: List all policies (active and inactive) for the caller's organization.

schema.title: Response List Policies Api V1 Policies Get

post.description: Create a new policy. Rules are validated at the API boundary.

patch.description: Update a policy. Validates rules if provided.

delete.description:
Soft-delete a policy (is_active → False).

Hard delete is avoided so that historical tool_request rows that reference
this policy_id still resolve for auditing purposes.

get.description: List all agent budgets for the caller's organization.

schema.title: Response List Budgets Api V1 Budgets Get

get.description: Get a single budget by ID.

patch.description:
Update budget caps for an agent. ADMIN and SECURITY only.

All fields are optional. Set a field to null to remove the cap (unlimited).

post.description:
Evaluate a proposed tool call through the PolicyEngine chokepoint.

Strict execution flow:
  1. Authenticate agent & construct CallerIdentity
  2. Call deterministic PolicyEngine (via Phase 6 Redis-wired factory)
  3. Create ToolRequest, AuditLog (with monotonic sequence_number), and HITLRequest if PENDING
  4. db.commit() -- HARD GATE: if commit fails, abort with 500 (mock tool never called)
  5. If ALLOW and mock handler exists, execute safe mock tool
  6. Return decision response to agent

get.description: List audit log records for the caller's organization in reverse chronological sequence.
Retrieve a single audit log record by ID within the caller's organization.

post.description:
Trigger cryptographic verification of the organization's tamper-evident hash chain.

Scans records sequentially from sequence 1 onwards. Early-exits on the first
detected discontinuity, sequence gap, or hash mismatch, identifying the exact
compromised record.

get.description: Retrieve a single HITL request by ID within the caller's organization.

post.description:
Approve a pending HITL request and resume tool execution.

Commit-Before-Execute Ordering:
  1. Verify PENDING status and non-expired.
  2. Update hitl_request to APPROVED and tool_request to APPROVED.
  3. Write and commit the HITL_APPROVED audit log entry.
  4. Execute mock tool handler (if registered).
  5. Write and commit the TOOL_EXECUTED / TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED audit log entry.
Deny a pending HITL request. No mock tool handler is executed.

get.description:
Return aggregate numbers for the dashboard home screen.

All values are scoped to the caller's organization. A single pass over
tool_requests is used for all decision-count metrics to avoid N+1.

Return a reverse-chronological feed of tool requests for polling.

Uses a single LEFT JOIN query with count to avoid N+1. The frontend should
poll this endpoint; WebSockets/SSE are explicitly deferred to Phase 14.

PolicyCreateRequest.title: PolicyCreateRequest
PolicyCreateRequest.description:
Create a new policy rule set.

`rules` must be a non-empty dict. The policy engine reads at minimum one of:
  - allowed_actions: list[str]
  - blocked_actions: list[str]
  - risk_thresholds: dict mapping risk level -> decision
Malformed rules are rejected at the API boundary.
